explication: OpenClaude is a terminal-first coding-agent CLI that brings cloud and local model providers into one workflow. A user enters a prompt in the CLI; the query engine prepares context, processes input, streams results, and records conversation history. Around that core, the product exposes tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, provider setup, and task workflows. The graph also shows persistence and permission handling. README capabilities fill out some unsampled subsystems; arrows are limited to documented behavior and sampled calls.
